name: DiffCIObserve
description: Shows which tests and checks a change affects, and why. Observation only: runs nothing, skips nothing, sends nothing, and never fails the pipeline.
helpMarkDown: Shows which tests and checks a pull request affects. [More information](https://github.com/DiffCI/core/blob/main/integrations/azure-devops/README.md)
author: DiffCI

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: DiffCI CLI version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Exact published `@diffci.com/diffci` version. Empty: the version this task was released with.

inputs.name: redactPaths
inputs.label: Redact paths
inputs.helpMarkDown: Replace every file path in the report with a stable 12-character digest.

inputs.name: uploadArtifact
inputs.label: Upload the report
inputs.helpMarkDown: Keep the JSON report and summary as a pipeline artifact.

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Fail on error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail this step when observation refuses or errors. Off by default, so a DiffCI problem never becomes the pipeline's result. Turn it on only while debugging an installation.

outputVariables.name: fullSuiteRequired
outputVariables.description: "false" only when DiffCI narrowed this change cleanly; "true" on any fallback, refusal or error.

outputVariables.name: affectedTests
outputVariables.description: JSON array of the affected test files when fullSuiteRequired is "false" and paths are not redacted. Empty otherwise.

outputVariables.name: affectedTestCount
outputVariables.description: Number of affected test files. Empty without an observation.

outputVariables.name: totalTestCount
outputVariables.description: Number of test files the full suite runs. Empty without an observation.

outputVariables.name: reason
outputVariables.description: One line on why the full suite is required. Empty when it is not.
